properties.summary: Svelte store for toast notification state management. Defines toast types, a writable store for active toasts, and functions to add/remove toasts with configurable duration.
Union type for toast notification severity levels: success, error, info, warning.
Writable Svelte store holding the list of active toast notifications.
Adds a new toast notification with a generated ID, auto-removes after the configured duration.
Removes a toast notification by ID from the store.
Toast notification UI component that renders a fixed-position stack of toast messages with type-based styling, icons, and dismiss buttons. Uses svelte/transition for fly-in animation.
Default export: Svelte component that displays a stack of toast notifications in the top-right corner with type-appropriate styling (success/error/info/warning) and fly-in transitions.

Core type definitions for the damage calculator. Defines all game data interfaces (weapons, armor, enchantments, perks, races, guilds, rings, runes, build state), stat configuration maps, utility functions for upgrades and proc coefficients, and weapon hit/damage type definitions.
Union type of all possible stat keys derived from STAT_CONFIG keys (e.g. dexterityBoost, physicalBoost, warding, etc.).
Partial record mapping StatKey to numeric values for representing stat distributions.
Set of stat keys that are represented as percentages (e.g. boosts, defenses, resistances).
Array of all stat key strings typed as StatKey[].
Interface for a playable race with passive ability, stat modifiers, cooldown modifiers, and armor penetration values.
Interface for a guild perk with name and numeric amount.
Interface for a guild rank with rank number, optional stats, and optional perks list.
Interface for a guild with name and array of ranks.
Record mapping string keys to optional numeric values for armor piece stats.
Interface for an individual armor piece (Helmet/Chestplate/Leggings) with type, description, upgrade level, stats, and perk.
Interface for a complete armor set with name, parts array, and optional tags.
Interface for a ring item with stats, upgrade level, perk name and amount.
Interface for a rune item with stats, cooldown, upgrade level, and optional perk.
Interface for a stat modifier with multiplier or addition type and numeric value.
Interface for an enchantment effect with name and value.
Interface for a full enchantment definition with category, stacking behavior, stat modifiers, effects, and optional notes.
Interface for a perk with name, description, and tags array.
Union type for equipment slots that can hold enchantments: helmet, chestplate, leggings, ring, rune.
Maximum upgrade level for equipment (value: 5).
Applies upgrade multiplier to a StatMap based on upgrade level. Positive stats are multiplied, negative stats are divided by the upgrade factor.
Union type for weapon blade types: Small Blade, Medium Blade, Heavy Blade, Hammer Head.
Union type for weapon handle types: Medium Handle, Long Handle, Pole.
Union type for damage/element type prefixes used in scaling keys (physical, magic, fire, water, air, hex, holy, earth, summon, dexterity).
Template literal type combining StatPrefix with 'Scaling' suffix (e.g. 'physicalScaling').
Type for a weapon blade with name, tier, bladeType, stats, optional attack speed, perks, and scaling factors.
Type for a weapon handle with name, tier, handleType, stats, optional attack speed, perks, and scaling factors.
Union type for monk glove types: Gloves, Shield.
Union type for monk essence types: Monk Essence.
Interface for a monk glove weapon with tier, stats, attack speed, damage type proportions, scaling factors, and optional perk.
Interface for a monk essence weapon with tier, stats, attack speed, scaling factors, and optional perk.
Comprehensive interface for the entire character build state including race, guild, equipment slots, enchantments, infusions, weapon arts, buffs, potions, and various toggles.
Discriminated union for proc coefficient: noProc, or hasCoeff with a numeric value.
Extracts the numeric proc coefficient value from a ProcCoefficient, defaulting to 1 if undefined.
Checks if a proc coefficient allows proccing (value > 0).
Union type for proc scaling behavior: 'normal', 'ignore', or 'positiveOnly'.
Union type for attack types that boosts can apply to: m1, m2, wa, rune, perk.
Interface for a damage/heal boost entry with source name, multiplier, optional condition, attack type filter, and proc configuration.
Interface for the result of boost calculations, containing damage entries and final multiplier.
Maps scaling stat keys to their corresponding boost stat keys (e.g. 'physical' -> 'physicalBoost').
Interface for a weapon hit entry with hit number (n) and hit count.
Union type for weapon hit data: either a simple number or a WeaponHitObject.
Interface for weapon base damage data including type, M1/M2 hit arrays, optional finisher flag, and M2 charge configuration.
UI badge/pill component with multiple color variants (green, amber, red, purple, blue, teal, muted, draco), size variants (xs, sm, md), and shape/style options (square, solid, mono, tag).
Default export: Svelte component rendering a styled inline badge/pill with configurable variant, size, color, and shape.
UI button component with variants (default, positive, negative, warning, info, neutral), sizes (sm, md, lg), active state, and disabled support.
Default export: Svelte component rendering a styled button with variant, size, active/disabled states, and click handler.
UI card/container component with variants (default, surface, ghost), hover effect, color accents (green/amber/red/purple/blue/teal/draco), and configurable padding and gap sizes.
Default export: Svelte component rendering a styled card container with optional accent, hover, and click behavior.
UI horizontal divider component with color variants (green/amber/red/purple/blue/teal/draco) and configurable vertical spacing (none/sm/md/lg).
Default export: Svelte component rendering a themed horizontal rule with color and spacing variants.
Barrel file that re-exports all UI components (Card, Badge, Button, Stat, Section, Divider, Panel) from the ui module.
Re-export of Card component from Card.svelte.
Re-export of Badge component from Badge.svelte.
Re-export of Button component from Button.svelte.
Re-export of Stat component from Stat.svelte.
Re-export of Section component from Section.svelte.
Re-export of Divider component from Divider.svelte.
Re-export of Panel component from Panel.svelte.
UI panel/section container component with gradient background, color variants (green/amber/red/purple/blue/teal), optional header slot, and configurable padding.
Default export: Svelte component rendering a styled panel with gradient background, optional header slot, and color variant.
Animated numeric value display component that animates transitions between values with an easing function, supporting prefix/suffix text and negative value highlighting.
Default export: Svelte component that displays numeric values with roll/transition animation between state changes, parsing prefix-suffix format and highlighting negative values in red.
UI section container component with title/header, color variants (green/amber/red/purple/blue/teal/draco), and configurable gap size.
Default export: Svelte component rendering a titled section container with color accent variant and configurable content gap.
UI stat display component with label-value layout, color variants (green/amber/red/purple/blue/teal), size variants (sm/md/lg), and hover effect.
Default export: Svelte component for displaying a labeled stat value with color and size variants, supporting children or direct value prop.
UI color and label constants for damage types, tag groups, source types, enchant rarities, negative stats, stat labels, and tag labels used across the UI.
Object mapping damage types, tag groups, source types, enchant rarities, and negative stats to their hex color values.
Object mapping source type keys to their display labels (e.g. rune->'Rune', weaponArt->'W. Art').
General utility functions for the calculator: multiplier rounding, warding debuff calculation, HTML text highlighting/search, and proc chance calculation.
Rounds a multiplier value to 4 decimal places (multiply by 10000, round, divide by 10000).
Calculates the warding debuff damage multiplier: for positive warding uses 1/(1+pct), for negative uses 1-pct.
Splits text into segments marking which parts match a search query for highlighted rendering. Returns array of {text, highlight} objects.
Computes the actual proc chance for a given effect based on base chance, proc coefficient, and scaling type (normal/ignore/positiveOnly).
Autocomplete suggestion dropdown component that displays filtered suggestions with highlighted query matches, supporting name and perk type labels.
Default export: Svelte component rendering a suggestion dropdown list with highlighted search text, dispatching 'select' events for name/perk choices.
Collapsible tag-based filter panel component with grouped tags (Combat, Support, Status, Weapon Art/Rune, Special), active tag chips, clear-all functionality, and color-coded UI.
Default export: Svelte component providing an expandable tag filter with grouped tags, active state management, and event dispatching for tag toggle and change events.

Collapsible weapon stat filter component with grouped stat chips (Damage Type, Scaling, Boost/Stats), include/exclude cycling, active filter display, and a matchesFilter exportable function for external filtering.
Default export: Svelte component providing expandable weapon stat filtering with include/exclude toggling, active chip display, and reusable matchesFilter function.
Exported function that checks if a weapon data object matches the current active filter rules (include/exclude per stat key).
Weapon stats display component that categorizes and renders weapon stats into three groups: damage types, scaling values, and boost stats, with appropriate formatting and color-coded pills.
Default export: Svelte component that splits and displays weapon stats as categorized stat pills (damage types, scalings, boosts) with color-coded labels.

Unit tests for Piercer perk conditional boost logic and true damage type conversion. Tests getWeaponConditionalBoost with various weapon types, validates Piercer scaling, and tests boostDmgTypes cross-type leak prevention for Piercer conversions.
Test suite validating getWeaponConditionalBoost for Piercer perk: 20% per rank on eligible weapons (doubled effect), 10% base on non-eligible, non-stacking, correct scaling.
Test suite for applyPiercerTrueConversion helper: rank 0 passthrough, rank 1-10 conversion to true damage, multi-type preservation.
Test suite for boost type mapping across damage types after Piercer conversion: verifying boost entries like Rage correctly propagate to true damage types.
Test helper function that converts all weapon damage types to pure true damage based on Piercer rank: true = 1 + 0.1*rank multiplier.
Test helper function that resolves boost types for each damage type, using key-matched boosts or union of all boosts for unmatched keys.
Project-level constants file (referenced by toast.ts for DEFAULT_TOAST_DURATION_MS).
Damage type constants (DMG_TYPE_COLORS, DMG_TYPE_PRIORITY) re-exported by types.ts.
Elemental boost stat definitions used by WeaponStatFilter for the Boost/Stats group.
Filter action helpers (createFilterActions) used by WeaponStatFilter for include/exclude toggle logic.
Shared StatChip component used by WeaponStatFilter for rendering individual stat filter chips.
Weapon conditional boost data (getWeaponConditionalBoost) tested by piercer.test.ts for Piercer perk behavior.
